enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed with eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns head to the left. Adjusts pillow with left hand. Pulls blanket up to chin. Turns onto right side. Bends left knee. Straightens left leg. Turns onto back. Moves right arm under pillow. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket down slightly. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Turns on shower faucet. Adjusts water temperature. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Puts toothbrush down. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast with toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, butter, milk. Closes refrigerator. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on stove. Turns on stove. Waits for kettle to boil. Pours boiling water into cup. Adds tea bag. Waits for tea to steep. Removes tea bag. Adds milk. Stirs tea. Sits at table. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Cleans up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a leisurely morning walk around the neighborhood
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on shoes. Opens front door. Steps outside. Closes door. Walks down the path. Turns left at the sidewalk. Continues walking. Crosses street. Walks past houses. Turns around. Walks back. Opens front door. Enters house. Closes door. Removes shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living areas as weekly chores
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Opens storage closet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Plugs cord into outlet. Turns on vacuum. Pushes vacuum across floor. Pulls vacuum back. Moves around furniture. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs cord. Wraps cord around vacuum. Puts vacuum back in closet. Picks up items from floor. Places items on shelves. Wipes coffee table with cloth. Fluffs pillows. Arranges pillows on sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning personal projects at the desk with the lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens notebook. Picks up pen. Writes notes. Turns page. Reads book. Highlights text. Closes book. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Opens calendar. Writes down plans. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a light lunch at home
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lettuce, tomato, cheese. Closes refrigerator. Takes out cutting board. Places lettuce on board. Picks up knife. Cuts lettuce. Cuts tomato. Opens bread bin. Takes out bread. Places cheese on bread. Adds lettuce and tomato. Closes sandwich. Places sandwich on plate. Pours glass of water. Sits at table. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Cleans plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote control. Presses power button. Changes channels. Adjusts volume. Puts remote down. Watches TV. Occasionally shifts position. Picks up remote again. Changes channel. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping for the coming week
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up reusable bags. Walks to car. Opens car door. Sits in driver seat and starts car. Drives to grocery store. Parks car. Turns off engine. Steps out of car. Walks to store entrance. Picks up shopping cart. Pushes cart through aisles. Selects items from shelves. Places items in cart. Proceeds to checkout. Places items on conveyor belt. Pays for groceries. Bags groceries. Loads bags into car trunk. Drives home and parks car. Takes bags into house.

Places grocery bags on counter. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Places milk in refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Places vegetables in crisper drawer. Takes out meat. Places meat in refrigerator. Closes refrigerator. Opens pantry. Places cans on shelf. Closes pantry. Folds reusable bags. Puts bags in closet. Wipes counter with cloth. Washes hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a personal creative hobby at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens drawer. Takes out sketchbook. Picks up pencil. Draws lines. Erases. Draws more. Takes out colored pencils. Colors drawing. Puts down pencil. Closes sketchbook. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken, vegetables. Closes refrigerator. Places chicken on cutting board. Cuts chicken. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Places chicken in pan. Stirs. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Cleans plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and enjoying the evening
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Browses channels. Settles on a program. Places remote on armrest. Watches TV. Shifts position. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Watches more TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on faucet. Picks up sponge. Applies dish soap. Picks up plate. Scrubs plate. Rinses plate. Places plate in dish rack. Picks up glass. Scrubs glass. Rinses glass. Places glass in dish rack. Turns off faucet. Picks up cloth. Wipes counter. Wipes stove. Wipes sink. Rinses cloth. Hangs cloth. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Closes book. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls screen. Taps screen. Reads content. Puts phone down. Picks up book again. Turns page. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Picks up phone. Scrolls. Puts phone on nightstand. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Night wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on faucet. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns off faucet. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the fan on and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on fan. Adjusts fan speed. Lies on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Falls asleep.
